notes.title: The MEGA Update 1.1.0.0
notes.notes:
In this mega update we’ve given you the choice to go first person and play NERVE from a whole new perspective – literally!
First person mode is so good that the game actually feels slower, giving you more time to react. So, we’ve given you a Boost speed slider too! Can you crank it up to the max and keep your vessel under control? Let’s see!
We’ve also made huge overhauls to the level design of Worlds 5, 7, and 8 so be sure to check them out in World Select and go for a new high score!
This completes our first pass revision of all 10 Worlds after listening to the community’s feedback but we’re not stopping there and will continue to listen to our players and react to what they want to see next!
Share your thoughts on our discussion boards, join the incredible Discord community, or leave a review and let us know what you think! Welcome to the frantic chaos!


New Additions

EXPERIMENTAL: First Person Mode (accessed in Gameplay Options)
EXPERIMENTAL: Boost Multiplier adjustment slider (accessed in Gameplay Options)



Updates

World 5 ALL Zones level design updated and flow improved
World 6 Zone 1 level design updated and flow improved
World 7 ALL Zones level design updated and flow improved
World 8 ALL Zones level design updated and flow improved
Decreased number of rows in Barricade Nodule attacks in World 8 Petulmuta Gatekeeper battle

Bug Fixes

World 3 Spinaclyp Gatekeeper's health will no longer increase when entering final phase of battle

notes.title: Update 1.0.4.0
notes.notes:
Major changes to World 6 Fugendito's flow as well as reducing the number of unique Snare Trap types throughout the game in both Zones and that are spawned by Gate Keepers to remove some of the RNG gameplay surrounding them,

Other notable mentions: Gate Keeper's health bars are now segmented to show their stages, there have been several improvements to the Desoforn Gate Keeper battle, and a World Reset option has been added to the pause menu in World Select races.

Enjoy the frantic chaos!

Reset World option added to Pause and Death menus in World Select gameplay
Added Options in Gameplay Options to change Brake, Boost, Focus and Vault controls to be toggles

Unumpuriss Gate Keeper will only create Suicide Snares or 2 lane Snares

Zone gate transition particle effects position and timing have been improved

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.0
notes.notes:

World 2 Avemcaec Leaderboards have been reset following World 1 reset as they also contained unachievable scores

Turning speed is now clamped so that it can’t be doubled by using controller and keyboard together

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
There has been a large overhaul the Seeker Trap logic to allow for faster gameplay when facing them. The player will still interact with Seekers in the same way using Focus however now they can be dodged and moved away from much more quickly. This should allow for faster feeling gameplay whilst keeping their original design intact for those familiar with how they work. We have also done several tweaks to their logic to hopefully overcome a bug  where they were killing the player when first interacted with.

There have also been improvements to collision on several Trap types and we have fixed an issue where player progress would be lost in World Select if the player selected New Game from the Campaign. Various Zones have also had level design tweaks to make them smoother and easier as a whole.


Updates

 Seeker Traps will now enter their attack state even if you are already holding the Focus button
 Seeker Traps will now react more quickly and take less time to avoid
 Leaderboards should now hopefully be reset although we'll need to await player testing to properly confirm
 World 1 Zones 5, 6, 9 level design updated
 World 2 Zones 1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 9 level design updated

 World 9 Zones 1, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10 level design updated

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Minor update with a hotfix for Gate Keeper's death sequences being skippable by restarting the zone, player can no longer reset Zone during death sequence. However, this change means that we have had to purge the Leaderboards to ensure parity across all scores, we deeply apologise to anyone who has lost their score and hope to see you on the leaderboards again soon!

We have also fixed an issue with Spinaclyp that caused the ground debris it creates to continue being created after the player had died.

Bug Fixes

 Restart Zone button is now disabled during Gate Keeper Death sequences to stop skipping
 Spinaclyp's ground debris attack now properly resets on player death
 Spinaclyp battle has been split into 3 parts

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.0 | RELEASE
notes.notes:
Welcome to our release update! We've played NERVE again again, finding the rough edges and filing them down! Welcome to the Frantic Chaos. Welcome to the NERVE we've been working tirelessly to bring you. You are not ready...

RACE | DODGE | DIE | REPEAT

notes.title: Update 0.5.0.0: World 10 | UNUMPURISS
notes.notes:
This update concludes NERVE’s campaign! What are you waiting for racer, get in there and finish it!

 Prepare to enter a World formed of raw ethereal power. Crafted, meddled, and destroyed by the omnipotent ruler of the Gate Keepers. You must surpass every surprise they throw at you before you may even face their true form waiting for you at the end of this World. Prepare to die and be reborn again and again in their name. Prepare to enter the World of Unumpuriss.
You are not ready….

This update brings with it the completed OST for the campaign with the music tracks for Worlds 7 to 10 now included. Prepare to race through these Worlds and feel their pumping tracks spurring you on as you push yourself to get your fastest time yet!

We now have per-zone auto-saving too! This means that any crashes or unwarranted closing of NERVE will no longer result in loss of progression. You’ll return to whichever zone you were last racing in!


New Additions

 World 10 “UNUMPURISS”
 Per-Zone Auto-Saving in Campaign (previously per-World)
 World 7 music track that changes as you traverse through the World
 World 8 music track that changes as you traverse through the World
 World 9 music track that changes as you traverse through the World
 World 10 music track that changes as you traverse through the World
 Added World 9 tutorials that explain the World and Rotation pick-ups


Updates

 Changed front end background colour to represent World 10
 Updated Focus tutorial text to better represent how the Focus mechanic works
 Various level design tweaks to make some zones less punishing
 More options added to Video Options to better control graphical performance
 Improved visuals of Desoforn Gate Keeper battle attacks and Traps
 Added cam shake effects throughout game
 Rotation pick-up particles are now clearer
 Improved visuals of Rank images


Bug Fixes

 Resolution Options now work as intended
 Rotator pick ups in World 9 Zone 8 will no longer force you into a laser beam
 Fixed several spawned sequence Boss Traps that weren’t animating

notes.title: Update 0.4.0.0: World 9 | ILLUDOLET
notes.notes:
Get ready to enter a dimension birthed in outer space. Where worlds collide - as we combine the mechanics of all the previous Worlds. As if that were not terrifying enough, you’ll also discover a new pick-up that when hit will force you to turn to a specific rotation. Are these rotation pick-ups there to help you or hinder you – you decide. Prepare to enter the space realm of ILLUDOLET.

We’ve had a huge music update from our stellar composer as unique tracks have now been created for Worlds 4, 5, and 6! Jump in and experience these pumping tracks as you race through the chaos of NERVE’s Worlds!

We’ve also added Feedback and Bug report buttons to the pause and death menus. Help us improve NERVE to be the most chaotic, frantic, edge-of-your-seat experience it can be!

New Additions

 World 9 “ILLUDOLET”
 World 4 music track that changes as you traverse through the World
 World 5 music track that changes as you traverse through the World
 World 6 music track that changes as you traverse through the World
 Added feedback and bug report buttons to Pause and Death menus


Updates

 Lowered FOV change intensity when entering Boost state
 Camera shake added to Trap and Boss sequences across game
 Added particle effects to Braking state and Focus state
 “Near Miss” audio volume lowered
 World objects now have a Fresnel effect like the Traps on the causeway

 Where possible, bosses have been moved closer to the player to make them more intimidating

Bug Fixes

 Fixed various spacing issues within UI elements in front end

notes.title: Update 0.3.0.0: World 8 | PETULMUTA
notes.notes:
In this update, you’ll be thrown into a World inspired by the murky dark depths of the ocean. Prepare to face jellyfish-like Tethers that latch on to you and manipulate your abilities! Travel deep enough and you’ll reach the lair of the World’s writhing and raging Gate Keeper waiting to pull you into the deep! Welcome to PETULMUTA.

We’ve also added custom keyboard and controller input options, which you can find under Options > Controls. Now you can change the controls to what fits your style best!

New Additions

 World 8 “PETULMUTA”
 Keyboard and controller controls customisation
 World 2 music track that changes as you progress through the World
 World 3 music track that changes as you progress through the World
 Selecting the various Worlds in World Select will now change the background colour palette

Bug Fixes

 Welcome Screen will now update to show controller or keyboard icons depending on player’s current input
 Rebounded projectiles on Gate Keepers will no longer interrupt certain animation sequences that were causing the Boss to get stuck
 Fixed Projectiles that are spawned by Fugendito being reboundable when they shouldn’t be (dark type Projectiles)

notes.title: Update 0.2.0.0 : World 7 | DESOFORN
notes.notes:
We're turning up the heat in World 7, the world of DESOFORN! Filled with searing insta-killing lava beams, equipable protective shields, 10 new zones to race through, and an all-new ungodly machine-like Gate Keeper waiting for you at the end.

You can also now disable the Death menu, causing you to immediately respawn after death (accessed in Gameplay Options), and we've added in a Zone timer so that you score enthusiasts can keep a closer eye on your current time!

New Additions

 World 7 "DESOFORN".
 Active Zone timer to show current zone time during play.
 Autosave system. Game will now automatically save your progress after you have defeated a World Gate Keeper.
 Toggle option which will enable/disable the death menu (Community Request).


Updates

 Minimum required times for Ranks have been revisited to make them more challenging across World 1-6.
 Decreased animation length of Seeker Trap animation.
 Changed the texture on World 5 Projectiles to be more distinct.
 Added particle effects to Seeker Traps.

 Added VFX to the eyeball opening animation.

 Improved World 2 Avemcaec Gate Keeper SFX & VFX.

 Improved flow of Tutorial screen animations.

Bug Fixes

 Bounding box resized on Projectile VFX so they don't disappear when partially off screen.
 Fixed some bosses eyes respawning improperly.
 Fixed Zone Rank UI showing when you load in from a save game.
 Fixed Zone transition VFX playing when you load in a save game.

 Fixed leaderboard slots showing incorrect rankings.

SFX implemented on various Traps
